Close-up of the burned grimoire resting on the green leather surface of the court table.
Close-up of Lady Juliana lifting her chin without an ounce of hesitation.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: No.
Medium shot of the Judge lowering his brow with dark finality.

events_summary.speaker: JUDGE
events_summary.content: Think carefully.
Low-angle close-up of Lady Juliana looking skyward through the arched court windows.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: I have.
Medium shot of the Judge pointing an outstretched finger across the bench, his tone hardening into lethal severity.

events_summary.speaker: JUDGE
events_summary.content: You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?
Close-up of Lady Juliana unflinchingly accepting her fate.

events_summary.speaker: JULIANA
events_summary.content: Then let it be.
Medium shot of Prudence breaking into shattered sobs, pressing her apron to her face to muffle her tears.
